table.name: alignment
table.purpose: Lookup table of superhero moral alignments (Good, Bad, Neutral, N/A), referenced by the superhero table to classify each hero's alignment.

col_001.name: alignment_id
col_001.description: Primary key of the alignment lookup table; surrogate integer identifier referenced by superhero rows (superhero.col_004 and superhero.col_010) to indicate the hero's alignment.

col_002.name: alignment_name
col_002.description: Human-readable alignment label: Good, Bad, Neutral, or N/A (unknown/not applicable).

table.name: attribute
table.purpose: Lookup table of hero attributes (stat categories) used to score superheroes, e.g. Intelligence, Speed, Durability, Combat, Power, Strength. Referenced by hero_attribute and superhero columns for attribute scores.

col_001.name: attribute_id
col_001.description: Primary key of the attribute lookup table; integer 1-6, one row per attribute. Referenced by hero_attribute and by superhero score columns.

col_002.name: attribute_name
col_002.description: Name of the attribute/stat category: Intelligence, Speed, Durability, Combat, Power, Strength (6 distinct values).

table.name: colour
table.purpose: Lookup table of colours (35 rows), referenced by superhero eye/hair/skin colour columns and hero_attribute. Each row is one colour with a unique name.

col_001.name: colour_id
col_001.description: Primary key; surrogate identifier for a colour, 1-35, referenced by superhero colour columns and hero_attribute.

col_002.name: colour_name
col_002.description: Unique human-readable colour name (e.g. Black, Magenta, Pink, Strawberry Blond, Silver).

table.name: gender
table.purpose: Lookup table of gender categories used to classify superheroes (referenced by the superhero table). Each row is one gender label with its surrogate key.

col_001.name: gender_id
col_001.description: Surrogate primary key for the gender lookup table; small integer (1-3) referenced by other tables (e.g. superhero) to indicate a character's gender.

col_002.name: gender
col_002.description: Gender label: 'Male', 'Female', or 'N/A' for unknown/not applicable.

table.name: hero_attribute
table.purpose: Junction table assigning attribute scores (e.g. Intelligence, Speed, Power) to superheroes; one row per hero per attribute with a numeric rating from 5 to 100.

col_001.name: hero_id
col_001.description: Reference to superhero.col_001, the hero this attribute score belongs to. 623 distinct heroes, each appearing 6 times (once per attribute).

col_002.name: attribute_id
col_002.description: Reference to attribute.col_001, the attribute being scored (1=Intelligence, 3=Speed, 4=Durability, 5=Power, 6=Combat; 2 likely Strength). Joins to colour/publisher are spurious coincidences.

col_003.name: score
col_003.description: The hero's rating for the attribute, on a 5-100 scale (multiples of 5, mean ~52). Joins to superhero/superpower are spurious.

table.name: hero_power
table.purpose: Junction/association table linking superheroes to their superpowers (many-to-many between superhero and superpower).

col_001.name: hero_id
col_001.description: Foreign key to superhero.col_001, identifying which hero has the power. 652 distinct heroes, each appearing multiple times (one row per power).

col_002.name: power_id
col_002.description: Foreign key to superpower.col_001, identifying which superpower the hero possesses. 167 distinct powers. Also statistically joins to superhero.col_001, but that is likely coincidental overlap of integer IDs; the superpower reference is the intended one.

table.name: publisher
table.purpose: Lookup table of publishers/creators of superhero characters (comic studios, media companies, authors). Referenced by superhero and hero_attribute tables. One row per publisher.

col_001.name: publisher_id
col_001.description: Primary key; unique integer identifier for each publisher. Referenced by superhero.col_009 and hero_attribute.col_002.

col_002.name: publisher_name
col_002.description: Name of the publisher/creator (e.g. 'DC Comics', 'Sony Pictures', 'J. K. Rowling'). One row has an empty string, so some characters have an unknown/blank publisher.

table.name: race
table.purpose: Lookup table of superhero races/species (e.g. Human, Alien, Mutant, Android), referenced by several columns in the superhero table.

col_001.name: race_id
col_001.description: Primary key; unique integer identifier for each race. Referenced by several superhero columns (superhero.col_005 through col_009), which likely hold race-related attributes.

col_002.name: race_name
col_002.description: Unique name of the race/species (e.g. Human / Radiation, Inhuman, Mutant, Vampire, Android). '-' appears to denote an unknown/unspecified race.

table.name: superhero
table.purpose: One row per superhero/villain character, with physical attributes and references to lookup tables for alignment, colours, race, publisher and gender. This is the classic 'Superheroes' dataset (SuperHeroDb).

col_001.name: hero_id
col_001.description: Primary key of the superhero table; surrogate integer identifier referenced by hero_attribute and hero_power junction tables.

col_002.name: name
col_002.description: Superhero/villain name (alias), e.g. 'Green Lantern V', 'Jason Bourne', 'Iceman'. Not unique (750 rows, 743 distinct).

col_003.name: full_name
col_003.description: Character's real/secret identity full name, e.g. 'Jessica Viviana Cruz', 'Barbara Gordon'. '-' or null when unknown (125 rows are '-').

col_005.name: eye_colour_id
col_005.description: Foreign key to colour lookup; the character's eye colour. Most common values 7, 1, 9, 14, 23 correspond to common eye colours (e.g. blue, brown, green).

col_006.name: hair_colour_id
col_006.description: Foreign key to colour lookup; the character's hair colour. Distinct value distribution differs from col_005, consistent with hair colour.

col_007.name: skin_colour_id
col_007.description: Foreign key to colour lookup; the character's skin colour. Heavily skewed to value 1 (681/750), consistent with a dominant default skin colour.

col_008.name: race_id
col_008.description: Foreign key to race lookup (e.g. 24 likely 'Human', 1 likely 'Human / altered' or similar; 61=Zombie). 295 rows have value 1 and 219 have value 24, the two most common races.

col_009.name: publisher_id
col_009.description: Foreign key to publisher lookup: 13=Marvel Comics (387 rows), 4=DC Comics (224 rows), 15, 3, 1 other publishers.

col_010.name: gender_id
col_010.description: Foreign key to gender lookup: 1=Male (504), 2=Female (212), 3=other/unknown (28). The exact lookup table is not in the join list, but the distribution strongly matches gender.

col_011.name: height_cm
col_011.description: Character height in centimetres. 0 and null mean unknown; median ~178 cm, with outliers like 10800 cm for giant characters.

col_012.name: weight_kg
col_012.description: Character weight in kilograms. 0 and null mean unknown; median ~72 kg, with extreme outliers (up to 90,000,000) for non-human/giant characters.

table.name: superpower
table.purpose: Lookup table of superpowers/superhero abilities; one row per distinct power, referenced by hero_power and hero_attribute.

col_001.name: superpower_id
col_001.description: Primary key; unique surrogate identifier for each superpower (1-167).

col_002.name: superpower_name
col_002.description: Unique human-readable name of the superpower (e.g. 'Invisibility', 'Accelerated Healing').
